paper_title: VC-SAM2-UNet: View-Conditioned SAM2-UNet for Multi-Label Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation

segmentation.image_resize: Pillow bilinear to 352x352; no crop or aspect-preserving pad
segmentation.partial_label_validity: per-image, per-channel validity mask; invalid channels excluded from loss and metrics
segmentation.loss: masked BCE plus Dice averaged over final, side1, and side2 outputs
segmentation.model_selection: highest validation macro Dice; strict best checkpoint

view_classifier.resize: aspect-preserving bilinear resize then zero padding
view_classifier.selection_rule: five-seed mean macro-F1, then accuracy, worst-view recall, and stability; checkpoint by validation macro-F1
